native_boundary: Preflight API entry through normal CSV report completion, including parse/context/dependency/inventory/header work. Setup/imports excluded and separate. Outer process includes launch/artefact writes/shutdown.
instrumentation: No profiler or tracing wrappers during native timing. Separate cProfile observations use default elapsed clock. Cache info is process-lifetime since module import; profiled operation counts use the API/report boundary.
cache_design: At most 512 literal string/immutable regex keys and immutable component tuples. Every path request obtains current str(self); non-default regex and non-exact strings use uncached callbacks. No file selection/results, Path instances, models, bindings, existence or parsed-source data cached.
limits: Warm retained workload; no CPU affinity/frequency control or cache flushing. Background load/drift and overlaps remain.
No confidence interval or general speed-up/regression claim. No pooling between campaigns or source revisions.
Model/control/database sources and command lists guarded; not complete payload hashes for all GIS/raster/time series.
No solver, model edit, SMB benchmark, extra PR/worktree/venv, merge/release/retarget or parent change.
